content: Chat outputs brings together saved files produced while working with the agent. Open a result to review or edit it, with the access your role allows.

comment.text: Body of the AI Agents onboarding tour step that highlights the Chat outputs tab (or a file in it) inside an agent. Chat outputs is the UI name of the section with saved result files; it is the subject of the first sentence (singular).

usage.context:
hasItems &&
 agentHooks &&
 revealStep(
 isStandIn ? OUTPUTS_FILE_SELECTOR : OUTPUTS_TAB_SELECTOR,
 t("AiAgentsTour:AgentOutputsTitle"),
 t("AiAgentsTour:AgentOutputs"),
 callbacks,
 AI_AGENTS_TOUR_LABEL,
 agentHooks.outputs,
 isStandIn
 ? [OUTPUTS_TAB_SELECTOR]
